A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CGS-GAN work and provide readable main text, tables, equations, figures, and Appendices A.1–A.9. All material can be matched despite repagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original head-synthesis results, FID/FID3D comparisons, efficiency measurements, ablations, and appendix analyses in Section 5 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains original CGS-GAN experimental outcomes, including Tables 1–3, qualitative renderings, training analyses, and failure cases.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A.2 retain the same generator architecture, multi-view gradient averaging, discriminator conditioning without contrastive loss, removal of generator view-conditioning, and random-background augmentation.

E1.justification: Both versions use FFHQ and FFHQC for human-head synthesis with the same represented data and viewing scenarios. The appendix demonstrations are also retained.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain GSGAN and GGHead as comparators. Appendix A.4 and Table 3 retain EG3D, Mimic3D, and Gaussian Shell Maps; no comparator membership changes.

E3.justification: The 50,000-image FID evaluation, FID3D protocol with fixed frontal conditioning for baselines, evaluated resolutions, and training settings in Appendix A.1 are unchanged.

E4.justification: The multi-view, background-augmentation, and dataset-rebalancing analyses remain unchanged in Section 5 and Figure 6. Appendices A.6–A.7 retain identical failure cases and contrastive-loss collapse analysis.

E5.justification: The point-estimate tables and training-loss curve use unchanged reporting practices. No run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–3 and the qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, CGS-GAN FID remains 4.94 on FFHQ at 512 resolution and 4.53 on FFHQC at 512 resolution. All 17 figure images match.

T1.justification: Appendix A.7 retains the same contrastive-loss equation (1) and accompanying reasoning. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about stable training without view-conditioning, consistent 3D heads, efficient synthesis up to 2048 resolution, and FFHQC curation.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and interpretations are unchanged. Appendices A.3 and A.6 retain the same limitations concerning unseen rear views, residual occluders, masking failures, computational demands, and dataset bias.

D1.justification: Implementation details, optimizer settings, batch sizes, hardware, data-processing instructions, and stated project/checkpoint access information are unchanged, including the complete technical appendix.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 38 bibliography entries are unchanged. The positioning relative to prior NeRF-based and Gaussian-splatting GANs is retained.

P1.justification: Section 5 replaces an unresolved '??' cross-reference with 'Figure 5'. University affiliations are abbreviated to 'HU Berlin', and the author email footnote is removed. The narrative and section hierarchy otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block changes from two rows to one, allowing the full abstract to fit on the opening page. Figure 3 moves from page 6 to page 5, with associated main-text reflow. Figure/table content is preserved, and matched appendix page bodies are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v2 repairs the broken Figure 5 reference and keeps the abstract together on the first page, modestly improving navigation and readability. The scientific substance, results, and complete appendix evidence are preserved.
